title: 第七章 谁让我心善呢第八章 花开正艳
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;“什么？”
见疾风狼突然掉头逃遁，张邮大感吃惊，忙喝道。
“给我回去，干掉它！”
他挥动手中铁链，发出威胁。
珍禽园这些源兽，都经过特殊训练，对这些铁链有着天然的恐惧和服从。
那疾风狼见张邮挥动铁链，身形一滞。
但却不敢回头攻击那只幼崽，竟是换了一个方向，想要冲下高台。
“该死的畜生，给我滚回去！”
张邮顿时急了，这一场可是五万两的赌局。
即便他是吏部尚书之子，珍禽园股东，这也是一笔不小的数目。
更何况，他还想借机把顾尘风套进来。
于是，他赶忙追上去，继续挥舞铁链，阻拦疾风狼逃离。
一人一狼，在斗兽台上追赶起来，场面十分诡异。
台下的观众们，也是一头雾水。
这到底是怎么回事？
一只银瞳狐幼崽，能把一只即将成为狼王的疾风狼，吓成这样？
人群中，上官冰心凝视着那只银瞳狐幼崽，突然目光一缩。
“这不是银瞳狐幼崽！”
众人顿时被她的话吸引。

瑶音公主也投来惊诧的目光。
“冰心，这就是银瞳狐呀？”
“不，这是一只银月妖狼幼崽。”上官冰心语出惊人。
“银月妖狼！”
听到这个名字，在场众人都是心中一惊。
同为狼类源兽，银月妖狼的名气，可比疾风狼大的多。
成年的银月妖狼，实力都在通脉境以上，有不小几率，达到源气境。
甚至，在太荒岭深处，有人见过源海境的银月妖狼王。
源兽世界等级森严，尤其重视血脉。
这只银月妖狼的血脉，恐怕是这座珍禽园等级最高的。
而疾风狼与之同属狼类源兽。
天然的血脉压制下，疾风狼根本生不起抗衡之心。
此时，台上的顾尘风，看着四处赶狼的张邮，不禁心中好笑。
这只银月妖狼幼崽，他之前在广场闲逛时，就已发现。
当时它被当成银瞳狐，与其他银瞳狐幼崽，关在一个笼子里。
虽然小家伙身体很是虚弱，却引得其他幼崽，惊恐叫喊。
“好可怕的气息，麻麻……”
“谁特么把狼放进来了，好怕怕！”

read2(); "What?"
Seeing the Gale Wolf suddenly turning around and running away, Zhang You was greatly surprised and shouted hurriedly.
"Go back and kill it!"
He waved the chain in his hand and issued a threat.
These origin beasts in the rare bird park have undergone special training and have a natural fear and obedience to these iron chains.
The Gale Wolf froze when he saw Zhang You waving the iron chain.
But he didn't dare to turn around and attack the cub. He actually changed his direction and wanted to rush off the high platform.
"Damn beast, get back here!"
Zhang You suddenly became anxious. This was a 50,000-tael bet.
Even if he is the son of the Minister of Civil Affairs and a shareholder of the Rare Bird Garden, this is still a large amount of money.
What's more, he also wanted to take the opportunity to lure Gu Chenfeng in.
So, he hurriedly chased after him and continued to wave the chain to prevent the Storm Wolf from escaping.
One person and one wolf chased each other on the beast fighting platform. The scene was very strange.
The audience in the audience were also confused.
What the hell is going on?
Can a silver-eyed fox cub scare a gale wolf that is about to become the wolf king like this?
In the crowd, Shangguan Bingxin stared at the silver-eyed fox cub, and suddenly his eyes shrank.
"This is not a silver-eyed fox cub!"
Everyone was immediately attracted by her words.
Princess Yaoyin also cast a surprised look.
"Bing Xin, is this the silver-eyed fox?"
"No, this is a silver moon demon wolf cub." Shangguan Bingxin said in surprise.
"Silver Moon Demon Wolf!"
Everyone present was shocked when they heard this name.
Both are wolf origin beasts, and the Silver Moon Demonic Wolf is much more famous than the Gale Wolf.
The strength of adult Silver Moon Demon Wolf is above the Tongmai Realm, and there is a high chance of reaching the Origin Qi Realm.
In the depths of Taihuang Ridge, some people have even seen the Silver Moon Demon Wolf King in the Origin Sea Realm.
The world of Origin Beasts is very hierarchical, with special emphasis on bloodline.
The bloodline of this Silver Moon Demonic Wolf is probably the highest level in this rare bird park.
The Gale Wolf is also a wolf origin beast.
Under the suppression of his natural bloodline, the Gale Wolf simply couldn't resist.
At this time, Gu Chenfeng on the stage looked at Zhang You chasing wolves around and couldn't help but feel amused.
He had discovered this silver moon demon wolf cub before when he was wandering around the square.
At that time, it was regarded as a silver-eyed fox and was kept in a cage with other silver-eyed fox cubs.
Although the little guy was very weak, it caused the other cubs to scream in fear.
"What a terrible smell, Mom..."
"Who the hell let the wolf in? I'm so scared!"
